systems.tiers: an activity to be implemented under the CRVS Strategic Plan launched 10 August 2022; not described

note: The only system named, an 'automated CRVS data system' planned under the five-year costed CRVS Strategic Plan launched on 10 August 2022, is not described, so it is unclassified and gives no fact; the article otherwise reports ICAP's PEPFAR/CDC-funded support since 2015 for vital statistics reporting and cause-of-death coding piloted in seven health facilities.
